name: Lesnoe prikljuchenie
source: Ah, summer camps... How many events! How many emotions! Remember all your most joyful childhood adventures while reading these stories. Immerse yourself in the cozy romance of summer nights!
translation: 啊，夏令营……承载了多少精彩往事，又寄托了多少纯真情愫！在阅读这些故事的同时，重温童年岁月里最欢乐的冒险记忆，沉浸于夏夜温馨浪漫的氛围之中吧！
